headline: Contested Belt Sees Fresh Base Activity
war_summary: The latest returns show movement concentrating in a handful of unsettled sectors. Nevish Line has quickened from the previous edition, with five base events in two hours and 56 across the day; its ledger remains mixed at six Warden and two Colonial holdings. Weathered Expanse also reports three events in the latest two hours and 33 in 24, leaving six Colonial bases and three neutral. Callahan’s Passage, quiet in the earlier report, now records two events in two hours and 22 across the day, while its nine Warden and one Colonial holdings mark a sharply contested record. Palantine Berm has cooled at the immediate edge—no events in two hours—but still posts 40 for the day and six events in six hours. Mooring County has likewise fallen silent in the latest two-hour window after three events in six hours, retaining twelve Warden bases. Stonecradle has newly registered two events in two hours, with five in the day and its single Warden holding standing against eight Colonial bases. Elsewhere, activity is sparse or has gone quiet; no victor is recorded.
